findings.title: Restore the deserialize bound suppressed by deserialize_with
findings.detail: GetterObservation<T>'s result uses deserialize_with=captured_result, which requires T: Deserialize<'de>. The remote derive has no explicit deserialize bound and its only T-bearing field is excluded from Serde's inferred bounds. Locked serde_derive 1.0.229 de.rs:230-238 explicitly excludes deserialize_with fields; de.rs:665-700 generates a wrapper with those same unbounded generics. The generated wrapper therefore cannot call captured_result for arbitrary T. Adding a bound only on the later manual trait implementation does not constrain that independently generated wrapper. Add the appropriate explicit deserialize bound and validate with the normal leased build; retain all existing tests.
findings.validation: Static derivation-source proof only; no compiler executed.

findings.title: Require available parent holders in the complete project catalogue
findings.detail: A successful Project.getAllprojects() catalogue is accepted after removing the :nested holder while retaining :nested:library and its available parentProjectPath=:nested. The collection validation requires the root and compiled Basic modules; validate_project checks only that the parent string matches the lexical prefix, never that it resolves in the catalogue. This accepts an incomplete catalogue as authoritative all-project identity data, defeating P2a's holder preservation contract. Validate each available non-null parent against the completed project index without altering order or collapsing duplicate identities. Add a regression that removes only the :nested fixture entry; existing missing-root/compiled-module tests must remain unchanged.
